trailhead.label: Contrà Bergamini di Sopra above Valdagno, the published start

cautions: About half the loop is on quiet hamlet lanes with the odd car: keep your dog close there.
Two short stretches of road at the Mucciòn pass and at Contrada Preti: keep your dog on a short lead.
A low hill walk that gets hot in summer: go in spring or autumn, as the board suggests, or early in the day.
Carry water even though water points are listed.
Follow local signs, lead rules and temporary closures.

emergency.note: Call the European emergency number when urgent help is required. Connectivity is not guaranteed.

textIt.About half the loop is on quiet hamlet l: Circa metà dell’anello è su tranquille stradine di contrada con qualche auto: lì tieni il cane vicino.
textIt.Two short stretches of road at the Mucci: Due brevi tratti di strada al passo del Mucciòn e a Contrada Preti: tieni il cane al guinzaglio corto.
textIt.A low hill walk that gets hot in summer:: Una camminata in bassa collina che d’estate fa caldo: vai in primavera o in autunno, come suggerisce il sito, oppure al mattino presto.
